carta-fund-performance.headline: Fund Performance now reads Carta through its current tools. Rebuild it so it keeps loading as Carta's connector changes.

carta-home-build.headline: When Carta can't load, Home now says why and how to fix it, retries quietly when Carta is slow, and loads on its own when you come back after fixing the connection. Rebuild to get it.

carta-lp-summary.headline: Your firm’s branding now covers the whole page, not just the PDF. Switch looks from the logo and the page follows.

carta-soi.headline: SOI now has an Investment Cash Flows tab: every dated investment, proceed and terminal value behind Deal IRR, grouped by company and fund, following the same fund, as-of and exited filters.

carta-workhub-build.headline: When KYC forms are waiting on you, you can now choose which ones Claude helps you fill in: one, several or all of them. Rebuild to get it.
